title: Inside US-Israel fault lines on Iran, Saudi Arabia and Turkey
text:
Inside US-Israel fault lines on Iran, Saudi Arabia and Turkey

With Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu back in Washington, Al-Monitor hosted a live webinar on how divisions over Iran, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey are testing the US-Israel relationship under President Donald Trump. Al-Monitor's Diplomatic Correspondent Elizabeth Hagedorn moderated a timely discussion featuring:Ben Caspit, Israel Pulse Columnist for Al-MonitorDaniel B. Shapiro, former US Ambassador to Israel, distinguished fellow with the Atlantic Council’s Scowcroft Middle East Security InitiativeGönül Tol, Founding Director of the Middle East Institute's Turkey Program
